title: synth config
description: Schema for $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/synth/config.json. Every key is optional; an absent one keeps the built-in default.

$schema.description: URL of this schema. Written into a new config file so an editor knows what it is reading.

think.description: Ask for reasoning output. Turn off for models that do not support it.

auto_approve_safe_commands.description: Let a preset of read-only shell commands run without a prompt.

debug_log.description: Append every request and reply to this file.

max_turn_ms.description: How long one turn may run. 0 disables it.

max_turn_tokens.description: Tokens one turn may spend, prompt and completion together. 0 disables it.

skill_paths.description: Extra directories to look for skills in, searched in order.

num_ctx.description: Window to ask ollama to load a model with. Omit for the model's advertised maximum; 0 leaves the choice to the server.

host.description: Still read so an old config keeps working. Where a provider points lives in the database now.

model.description: Still read so an old config keeps working. The chosen model lives in the database now.

api_key.description: Still read so an old config keeps working. Keys belong in auth.json now.

think.description: Still read so an old config keeps working. Use the top-level think instead.

debug_log.description: Still read so an old config keeps working. Use the top-level debug_log instead.

ollama.description: Ollama-specific settings. Everything but num_ctx is the old single-provider shape, kept so an existing config still loads.

hooks.description: Commands run at selected agent lifecycle events.

hook_timeout_ms.description: How long a hook command may run before it is killed.

search_api_key.description: Brave Search API key for the web_search tool. Without one the tool scrapes DuckDuckGo's HTML results page, which needs no key but is throttled after a handful of searches. BRAVE_API_KEY overrides it.

delete_after_days.description: Sessions idle longer than this are deleted outright, taking their messages and tool calls with them. 0 never deletes a session.

shed_after_days.description: Sessions idle longer than this keep their transcript but lose stored reasoning and the full tool output behind each card. What the model was shown stays. 0 keeps every payload.

prune.description: What a prune throws away, on startup and on /prune. Ages are in days since a session was last touched.

bell.description: When a finished turn says so, by desktop notification and BEL. 'unfocused' needs the terminal to report focus; one that does not never rings, so use 'always' there. Under tmux both need focus-events and allow-passthrough on.

matcher.description: Exact tool name to match. Empty or absent matches every tool.

command.description: Shell command run from the project root.
A command to run a child process.

url.description: A remote server over Streamable HTTP.

headers.description: Extra headers for the remote server.
